scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n emu,web -c blue,green "bash tools/scripts/emulators.sh" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:4010 tcp:127.0.0.1:4030 && pnpm seed:emulator && turbo run dev"
scripts.build:release: BRAND_RELEASE=1 VITE_FIREBASE_EMULATOR_ENABLED=false turbo run build --filter spotlight --filter backstage --force
scripts.build:local: VITE_FIREBASE_EMULATOR_ENABLED=true turbo run build --filter spotlight --filter backstage
scripts.preview:local: pnpm build:local && concurrently -k -n emu,app -c blue,green "bash tools/scripts/emulators.sh" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:4010 tcp:127.0.0.1:4030 && pnpm seed:emulator && turbo run preview --filter spotlight --filter backstage"
scripts.pr-tests: pnpm format && turbo run ci && pnpm knip && pnpm test:seed && pnpm test:harness && pnpm test:ci-scripts && pnpm guard:beacon-dotenv && pnpm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.deploy:rules: BRAND_RELEASE=1 pnpm -s brand:apply && firebase deploy --only firestore,storage
scripts.deploy:indexes: BRAND_RELEASE=1 pnpm -s brand:apply && firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes
scripts.deploy:functions: BRAND_RELEASE=1 pnpm -s brand:apply && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:hosting: BRAND_RELEASE=1 pnpm -s brand:apply && pnpm build:release && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:all: pnpm deploy:rules && pnpm deploy:functions && pnpm deploy:hosting
